## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests or harness coverage
- [ ] `refactor` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check app scripts tests` passes
- [ ] `pytest --cov=app` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_specs.py` passes
- [ ] Specs, reference API, and harness agree with each other
- [ ] New behaviour has an acceptance criterion **and** a harness test
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files committed
